Components also take CollisionProfileName, CollisionEnabled, GenerateOverlapEvents, SimulatePhysics, NotifyRigidBodyCollision, EnableGravity.
description: Set one property; property may be dotted (Settings.Speed) with array indices (Tags[0]). value is JSON: numbers, strings, [x,y,z], {r,g,b,a}, object paths, enum names. Components also take CollisionProfileName, CollisionEnabled, GenerateOverlapEvents, SimulatePhysics, NotifyRigidBodyCollision, EnableGravity.

name: python_exec
summary: Run Python inside the editor (import unreal). Returns printed output and log.
description: Run Python inside the editor (import unreal). Returns printed output and log.

name: sequence_create
summary: Create a Level Sequence with a frame range.
description: Create a Level Sequence with a frame range.

name: sequence_key_add
summary: Add a key on a bound actor's track channel (e.g. channel 'Location.X').
description: Add a key on a bound actor's track channel (e.g. channel 'Location.X').

name: sequence_player_add
summary: Play an animation sequence in an existing state (wired to the state result).
description: Play an animation sequence in an existing state (wired to the state result).

name: sequence_track_add
summary: Bind a level actor (by label) and add a track: Transform | Visibility | Audio | Event | Fade (Fade/Audio/Event need no actor).
description: Bind a level actor (by label) and add a track: Transform | Visibility | Audio | Event | Fade (Fade/Audio/Event need no actor).

name: soundcue_create
summary: Create a Sound Cue (optionally wrapping a Sound Wave).
description: Create a Sound Cue (optionally wrapping a Sound Wave).

name: state_add
summary: Add a state to a state machine (first state becomes the entry); optional sequence plays in it.
description: Add a state to a state machine (first state becomes the entry); optional sequence plays in it.

name: statemachine_add
summary: Add a state machine to an Animation Blueprint's AnimGraph and wire it to the output pose.
description: Add a state machine to an Animation Blueprint's AnimGraph and wire it to the output pose.

name: struct_create
summary: Create a User Defined Struct with fields [{name, type}] (types as in bp_add_variable).
description: Create a User Defined Struct with fields [{name, type}] (types as in bp_add_variable).

name: system_ping
summary: Check the bridge answers; returns editor identity.
description: Check the bridge answers; returns editor identity.

name: tools_list
summary: List registered tools with their input schemas.
description: List registered tools with their input schemas.

name: transition_add
summary: Add a transition between two states (automatic=true uses the time-remaining rule).
description: Add a transition between two states (automatic=true uses the time-remaining rule).

name: widget_add
summary: Add a widget (TextBlock, Button, Image, VerticalBox, ...) under a panel (default: root).
description: Add a widget (TextBlock, Button, Image, VerticalBox, ...) under a panel (default: root).

name: widget_animation_add
summary: Add (or extend) a widget animation: track opacity | translation | scale | angle on a widget with keys [[seconds, value]] (translation/scale values are [x,y]). After bp_compile the animation is a variable; play it with PlayAnimation.
description: Add (or extend) a widget animation: track opacity | translation | scale | angle on a widget with keys [[seconds, value]] (translation/scale values are [x,y]). After bp_compile the animation is a variable; play it with PlayAnimation.

name: widget_bind
summary: Create a bound event node for a widget delegate (e.g. Button OnClicked) in the event graph.
description: Create a bound event node for a widget delegate (e.g. Button OnClicked) in the event graph.

name: widget_create
summary: Create a Widget Blueprint (UserWidget) with an optional root panel class (default CanvasPanel).
description: Create a Widget Blueprint (UserWidget) with an optional root panel class (default CanvasPanel).

name: widget_layout
summary: Lay out a widget in its parent. Canvas children: anchor (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight, TopFill, BottomFill, LeftFill, RightFill, Fill or [minX,minY,maxX,maxY]), position [x,y], size [w,h], alignment [x,y] (0..1 pivot), autoSize, zOrder. Box/overlay children: padding (number or [l,t,r,b]), hAlign (Left|Center|Right|Fill), vAlign (Top|Center|Bottom|Fill), fill (share of the remaining space).
description: Lay out a widget in its parent. Canvas children: anchor (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight, TopFill, BottomFill, LeftFill, RightFill, Fill or [minX,minY,maxX,maxY]), position [x,y], size [w,h], alignment [x,y] (0..1 pivot), autoSize, zOrder. Box/overlay children: padding (number or [l,t,r,b]), hAlign (Left|Center|Right|Fill), vAlign (Top|Center|Bottom|Fill), fill (share of the remaining space).

name: widget_set_prop
summary: Set a widget property by reflection (UE text form); prefix 'Slot.' targets the slot (e.g. Slot.Padding).
description: Set a widget property by reflection (UE text form); prefix 'Slot.' targets the slot (e.g. Slot.Padding).

name: widget_tree_get
summary: Widgets of a Widget Blueprint with parent, slot and variable flags.
description: Widgets of a Widget Blueprint with parent, slot and variable flags.
